# Storyboard — Resume Approved Acceptance Fixture

## S01

- `slide_id`: `S01`
- `role`: cover / recommendation
- `assertion_title`: Fund a measured checklist-onboarding pilot, not a universal rollout
- `audience_takeaway`: Approve a bounded test whose scope matches the strength of the evidence.
- `content_blocks`: thesis; one-quarter decision; synthetic-fixture disclosure
- `claim_ids`: []
- `source_ids`: []
- `visual_intent`: contrast a bounded pilot path with a crossed-out full-rollout path
- `layout_family`: cover/section
- `density_budget`: low; one assertion and two qualifiers
- `previous_link`: `START`
- `next_link`: What evidence makes even a bounded pilot worth testing?

## S02

- `slide_id`: `S02`
- `role`: evidence
- `assertion_title`: The checklist cohort shows an 8-point observed retention difference
- `audience_takeaway`: The association is promising but not causal.
- `content_blocks`: checklist 68/100; standard 60/100; 2026-Q2; “observed, non-randomized” qualifier
- `claim_ids`: [`CLM-001`]
- `source_ids`: [`SRC-001`, `SRC-003`]
- `visual_intent`: two denominator-preserving bars with an 8 percentage-point annotation and qualification
- `layout_family`: data/chart
- `density_budget`: medium; two values, one delta, one limitation
- `previous_link`: A bounded pilot needs a measurable signal.
- `next_link`: Does the checklist also change speed to value?

## S03

- `slide_id`: `S03`
- `role`: evidence
- `assertion_title`: Median time to first value is three days shorter in the checklist cohort
- `audience_takeaway`: The second observed signal supports testing the intervention.
- `content_blocks`: checklist six days; standard nine days; non-randomized cohort qualifier
- `claim_ids`: [`CLM-002`]
- `source_ids`: [`SRC-001`, `SRC-003`]
- `visual_intent`: a six-versus-nine day comparison emphasizing direction without causal language
- `layout_family`: comparison
- `density_budget`: low; two values and one caveat
- `previous_link`: Retention provides one signal.
- `next_link`: What would a self-service-only decision miss?

## S04

- `slide_id`: `S04`
- `role`: counterpoint
- `assertion_title`: Self-service reduces ambiguity, but complex rollouts still ask for live support
- `audience_takeaway`: Do not remove the facilitated path.
- `content_blocks`: four of six cite checklist clarity; two of six prefer live kickoff; three of six still cite integration friction
- `claim_ids`: [`CLM-003`]
- `source_ids`: [`SRC-002`]
- `visual_intent`: paired evidence cards showing benefit and unresolved need without treating interview counts as prevalence
- `layout_family`: comparison
- `density_budget`: medium; three qualitative observations and sample-size note
- `previous_link`: Cohort signals favor testing self-service.
- `next_link`: How should the pilot preserve both needs?

## S05

- `slide_id`: `S05`
- `role`: process / recommendation
- `assertion_title`: Segmenting the pilot protects complex accounts while testing self-service
- `audience_takeaway`: Route simple accounts to the checklist and complex accounts to checklist plus kickoff.
- `content_blocks`: eligibility screen; simple-account path; complex-account path; common measurement layer
- `claim_ids`: []
- `source_ids`: [`SRC-001`, `SRC-002`, `SRC-003`]
- `visual_intent`: one decision node feeding two onboarding paths that converge on measurement
- `layout_family`: timeline/process
- `density_budget`: high; one decision, two paths, three measures
- `previous_link`: Interview tension requires a segmented operating design.
- `next_link`: What approval and measurement decision is required now?

## S06

- `slide_id`: `S06`
- `role`: close / action
- `assertion_title`: Approve one quarter, three measures, and one explicit stop rule
- `audience_takeaway`: Fund the pilot only with retention, time-to-value, and support-load measurement plus a cohort-comparability check.
- `content_blocks`: approve scope; assign product and customer-success owners; predeclare measures; stop if complex-account experience worsens
- `claim_ids`: []
- `source_ids`: [`SRC-001`, `SRC-002`, `SRC-003`]
- `visual_intent`: action checklist with three measure tokens and a visible stop-rule guardrail
- `layout_family`: close/action
- `density_budget`: medium; four actions and three measures
- `previous_link`: The segmented pilot is the evidence-proportionate design.
- `next_link`: `END`
